scope: Declared third-party license metadata of tracked npm and Cargo locks, source snapshot only

method.npm: Git lock package license declarations; project root package is excluded from third-party entries
method.cargo: Existing exact-name/version Cargo.toml declarations and content SHA; missing manifests queried once from official crates.io exact-version API with checksum matched to Git lock

limitations: License declarations are not a legal opinion, complete source/header/copyright provenance audit or enabled-feature/binary reachability audit.
Cached crate archive integrity was not verified; cached manifest name/version and manifest SHA are recorded.
Exceptions and native/system libraries retain independent obligations.
External Python OCR runtimes, models, production deployments and system libraries are outside npm/Cargo coverage.
The intended source snapshot excludes node_modules, Rust caches, Python runtimes and models.
